text_block_list.text:
The Osaka Hai, a race Kitasan Black will also be running in.
Satono Diamond silently makes her preparations.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'm looking forward to racing Kita-chan, but I can't let myself get carried away.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
To become a "great Umamusume,"
I must determine the ideal self I should strive for.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
How can I contribute to the Umamusume world?
What should I accomplish as a "renowned Umamusume"?
I must discover the answer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I feel like Kita-chan is going to become someone who supports the Umamusume world
by hyping up the crowd and bringing smiles to their faces.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: So while using Kita-chan as a reference, I hope I can find something I'm capable of doing, but...
choice_data_list: Also, a "great Umamusume" needs to be strong too.
Also, a "great Umamusume" needs strength as well, you know.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Allowing oneself to be distracted and losing a race
is unacceptable for a "renowned Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
To win with a run befitting a "great Umamusume."
First, let us accomplish that.

The paddock was buzzing with talk
about Satono Diamond and Kitasan Black.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black versus Satono Diamond...
To think we get to see this showdown again!
I hope both of them do their absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
In last year's Osaka Hai, Kitasan Black
came in a close 2nd place. She must really want to win this time.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Ah! Diamond-chan came out!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Satono-o-o!
We're expecting a great run from you today, too!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Kitasaaaan!
Let's get our revenge for last year!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yes, absolutely!

"...A slight sense of incongruity.
Her aura felt different from the Kitasan Black I know so well."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
“—Dia-chan.
Um, there's something I wanted to tell you before the race.”

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Huh...?
What's the matter, Kita-chan?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Complete conquest of the Senior Year royal road is my goal!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: That's why I'm definitely not handing over the Osaka Hai!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Let's both have a great run, Dia-chan!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black carries a real air of dignity today.
As expected of last year's Umamusume of the Year.

"...I was overwhelmed.
Kitasan Black is so composed today that even Satono Diamond caught her breath."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (For a moment... I flinched at Kita-chan...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(If you lose in spirit, you can't win!!
So why am I...!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...I won't lose!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I won't lose, I won't lose!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes! I am going to win!!
